notes:
Opening the app is much faster — even with many tabs and reference-heavy notes open — and syncing now refreshes what's on screen without a restart.

**Fixes & polish**

- **Much faster startup.** The app no longer sits on a blank window while a busy session loads. On cold start it brings up only the tab you're looking at (the others load when you switch to them) and keeps the loading splash on screen until real content has painted — so opening a window full of tabs and reference-heavy notes takes a second or two instead of many. (Root-caused from a startup recording; #608.)
- **Reference-heavy notes open faster.** A note's "Mentioned in…" backlinks now render as you scroll instead of building every card up front, so opening a note that's linked from dozens of places no longer stalls. (#609.)
- **"Sync now" updates what you're looking at.** When a sync pulls in changes, the note list and open (unfocused) notes now refresh on their own — no more restarting the app to see edits that already arrived. (PRD Addendum 27 §X, Wave 1; #606.)

**Under the hood**

- The Journal day list and backlink cards are now virtualized (mounted on demand as they scroll into view) and background tabs mount lazily — removing the main-thread stall that made a multi-tab cold start appear frozen behind the transparent window. (#605, #608, #609.)
- Added a debug-level **startup profiler** on the dev channel that records a phase-by-phase cold-start timeline (tabs, editors, backlinks) to pin down and guard against startup regressions. (#607.)
